top_news.title: Body in trunk leads Delhi police to 20-year-old suspect; man arrested in Maharashtra
top_news.summary: Delhi Police arrested a 20-year-old man from Maharashtra in connection with the alleged murder of his friend, whose decomposing body was discovered hidden inside a storage trunk in a temporary shelter in the capital. According to the police, the body of 26-year-old Sunny was found inside a trunk at a jhuggi on Sunanda Bhandari Marg in Pandara Park, New Delhi, on Wednesday. Police reached the spot after receiving information about a foul smell emanating from the jhuggi and recovered the body. Sunny was involved in various kinds of work, including part-time cleaning jobs. The accused has been identified as Rakesh, a resident of Pandara Park and a friend of the deceased. He was unemployed at the time of the incident, police said. The accused and his associates were allegedly seen taking Sunny's motorcycle to another location. They subsequently stopped using their mobile phones. The police stated that Sunny was hit on the head with a blunt object, which resulted in his death. The motive for the murder is stated to be an old dispute between the two. A case of murder under Section 103(1) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) was registered in this regard. During the investigation, police teams examined CCTV footage from the crime scene and the surrounding routes. Following the investigation and raids, Rakesh was arrested in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar in Maharashtra on Thursday and was brought to Delhi on transit remand. Further investigation and questioning are underway. In a separate incident, a 73-year-old man was apprehended after his car allegedly hit a motorcycle parked on the roadside on Africa Avenue Road in Delhi's RK Puram area. The incident took place at around 10 pm on September 17 when the motorcycle was parked on Africa Avenue Road, on the stretch from Bhikaji Cama Place towards RK Puram Metro Station. articles.title: Body in trunk leads Delhi police to 20-year-old suspect; man arrested in Maharashtra
articles.summary: Delhi Police arrested a 20-year-old man from Maharashtra in connection with the alleged murder of his friend, whose decomposing body was discovered hidden inside a storage trunk in a temporary shelter in the capital. According to the police, the body of 26-year-old Sunny was found inside a trunk at a jhuggi on Sunanda Bhandari Marg in Pandara Park, New Delhi, on Wednesday. Police reached the spot after receiving information about a foul smell emanating from the jhuggi and recovered the body. Sunny was involved in various kinds of work, including part-time cleaning jobs. The accused has been identified as Rakesh, a resident of Pandara Park and a friend of the deceased. He was unemployed at the time of the incident, police said. The accused and his associates were allegedly seen taking Sunny's motorcycle to another location. They subsequently stopped using their mobile phones. The police stated that Sunny was hit on the head with a blunt object, which resulted in his death. The motive for the murder is stated to be an old dispute between the two. A case of murder under Section 103(1) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) was registered in this regard. During the investigation, police teams examined CCTV footage from the crime scene and the surrounding routes. Following the investigation and raids, Rakesh was arrested in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar in Maharashtra on Thursday and was brought to Delhi on transit remand. Further investigation and questioning are underway. In a separate incident, a 73-year-old man was apprehended after his car allegedly hit a motorcycle parked on the roadside on Africa Avenue Road in Delhi's RK Puram area. The incident took place at around 10 pm on September 17 when the motorcycle was parked on Africa Avenue Road, on the stretch from Bhikaji Cama Place towards RK Puram Metro Station.
